sentences: The longest increasing subsequence of a sequence is its largest order-preserving selection of entries whose values increase.
The question asks for the randomized streaming space needed to approximate its length within a factor of two.
The algorithm may use one pass or a fixed constant number of passes.
The source presents square-root-space deterministic bounds, but the communication problems underlying the deterministic lower bounds become easy with randomness.
A resolution therefore needs either a better randomized summary or a lower-bound argument that survives the extra power of random choices.
